import duckdb
conn = duckdb.connect\(''financial_agent.duckdb'', read_only=True\)

print\(''=== TABLES ===''\)
tables = conn.execute\(""SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = ''main''""\).fetchall\(\)
for t in tables:
    count = conn.execute\(f''SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM {t[0]}''\).fetchone\(\)[0]
    print\(f''  {t[0]}: {count} rows''\)

print\(\)
print\(''=== ENTITIES ===''\)
entities = conn.execute\(''SELECT entity_id, entity_name, entity_slug FROM entities''\).fetchall\(\)
for e in entities:
    print\(f''  id={e[0]}: {e[1]} \(slug: {e[2]}\)''\)

print\(\)
print\(''=== SOURCE FILES ===''\)
files = conn.execute\(''SELECT file_id, entity_id, filename, sheet_name, state FROM source_files''\).fetchall\(\)
for f in files:
    print\(f''  file_id={f[0]}, entity_id={f[1]}: {f[2]} | sheet={f[3]} | state={f[4]}''\)

print\(\)
print\(''=== LIVE FACTS SAMPLE \(per entity\) ===''\)
for e in entities:
    eid = e[0]
    sample = conn.execute\(''''''
        SELECT canonical_field, period, value_normalised, currency, is_derived
        FROM live_facts
        WHERE entity_id = ?
        ORDER BY canonical_field, period
        LIMIT 10
    '''''', [eid]\).fetchall\(\)
    print\(f''  {e[1]}:''\)
    for s in sample:
        derived = '' [DERIVED]'' if s[4] else ''''
        print\(f''    {s[0]}: {s[1]} = {s[2]:.2f} {s[3]}{derived}''\)

print\(\)
print\(''=== LIVE FACTS COUNTS PER ENTITY ===''\)
for e in entities:
    eid = e[0]
    total = conn.execute\(''SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM live_facts WHERE entity_id = ?'', [eid]\).fetchone\(\)[0]
    derived = conn.execute\(''SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM live_facts WHERE entity_id = ? AND is_derived = TRUE'', [eid]\).fetchone\(\)[0]
    print\(f''  {e[1]}: {total} total, {derived} derived''\)

print\(\)
print\(''=== CONFLICTS ===''\)
conflicts = conn.execute\(''SELECT conflict_id, entity_id, canonical_field, period, state FROM conflicts''\).fetchall\(\)
print\(f''  Total: {len\(conflicts\)}''\)
for c in conflicts:
    print\(f''    id={c[0]}, entity={c[1]}, {c[2]} | {c[3]} | {c[4]}''\)
")
